The extra row can hold its own copy (hard link or copy with its own prefix, needed for folder-order export) or reference the first row's file with the M3U8 listing it twice. At minimum record the skipped duplicate positions in the sidecar/M3U8.

title: Design question: video downloads usually pick AV1 (and HDR AV1 when available), which many devices and players cannot play
scenario: 1. A video playlist downloads with `-f bestvideo[ext=mp4]+bestaudio[ext=m4a]/best[ext=mp4]/best`. 2. Within ext=mp4, yt-dlp's YouTube sort is ('quality','res','fps','hdr:12','source','vcodec',...), with vcodec order ['av0?1','vp9.2','vp9','h265','h264',...]. At 1080p YouTube offers avc1 (137) and av01 (399), and AV1 wins; above 1080p mp4 has only AV1; 'hdr:12' prefers HDR10 AV1 when the upload has it. 3. The owner copies the Movies folder to a TV over USB, a car screen, an older Android phone, an iPhone without hardware AV1 (pre-A17 Pro), a Windows PC without the AV1 Video Extension, or an older Chromecast/Fire TV: black screen, won't open, or washed-out HDR. H.264 plays essentially everywhere. (The '/best' webm fallback is covered in F30.)
evidence: YtDlpPlugin.kt:315 `request.addOption("-f", "bestvideo[ext=mp4]+bestaudio[ext=m4a]/best[ext=mp4]/best")`. yt_dlp/extractor/youtube/_video.py:4204-4207 `_format_sort_fields: ('quality','res','fps','hdr:12','source','vcodec',...)`. yt_dlp/utils/_utils.py:5375 vcodec order `['av0?1', r'vp0?9\.0?2', 'vp0?9', '[hx]265|he?vc?', '[hx]264|avc', ...]`.
suggested_fix: For maximum compatibility (the owner's 'any device'), prefer H.264 SDR: `-f "bv*[ext=mp4][vcodec^=avc1]+ba[ext=m4a]/b[ext=mp4][vcodec^=avc1]/bv*[ext=mp4]+ba[ext=m4a]/b[ext=mp4]/b"` with `-S "hdr:sdr"`, plus `--merge-output-format mp4` and `--remux-video mp4` so fallbacks still end up as mp4. Optionally make it a per-playlist or global toggle ('Maximum compatibility, H.264 up to 1080p' vs 'Best quality, AV1'), defaulting to compatibility.

title: The sidecar drops segment actionType/votes/locked/description and track downloadedAt, and app settings are never exported
scenario: 1. SponsorBlock 'poi_highlight' segments are stored with actionType 'poi' as a 1-second range, and the owner has set Highlight to 'Auto skip' (the UI offers all three actions for every category). 2. Before the reinstall shouldSkip is false because actionType != 'skip'. 3. After import, actionType falls back to the column default 'skip', so playback now skips one second at every highlight point; the track keeps sponsorBlockCheckedAt and 'sponsorblock'-sourced rows, so the backfill never re-fetches and corrects them. 4. votes, locked and description, including on the owner's override rows, are lost. 5. downloadedAt is reset to the import time. 6. App-wide settings (download subtitles, subtitle languages, pause on interruption, mobile-data downloads) live only in SharedPreferences and are in no export.
evidence: Sidecar segments are written as `{'source','uuid','category','startMs','endMs'}` only; DiscoveredSponsorBlockSegment has only these fields; the import companion sets no actionType, so `withDefault(const Constant('skip'))` applies. `bool get shouldSkip => action == SponsorBlockCategoryAction.autoSkip && actionType == 'skip';` (playback_service.dart:73-74). Import sets `downloadedAt: Value(row.status == 'complete' ? DateTime.now() : null)`.
suggested_fix: Write and parse actionType (default 'skip' when absent, for older sidecars), votes, locked, description and createdAt per segment, and downloadedAt per track. Add a library-level `/storage/emulated/0/Music/WoolyTube/woolytube_settings.json`, written on every settings change and offered for restore during import. Bump the sidecar 'version' to 2 and add a write -> parse -> import round-trip test that compares every column.

title: Reconcile treats 'file not visible' as 'file deleted' and permanently clears isLocalReplacement, e.g. when it runs before All-files access is granted
scenario: All-files access is missing: the owner revoked it, or after a reinstall Android Auto Backup restored woolytube.sqlite from app_flutter (the manifest does not set allowBackup=false) and the owner backed out of the permission screen. initProvider calls openAppSettings() and carries on; recoverInterruptedDownloads then reconciles every playlist. Files this install does not own are invisible, so every complete track is reset to pending with filePath cleared and isLocalReplacement=false. Once the permission is granted, reconcile re-adopts the files by prefix, but the replacement flag is gone for good. As a result SponsorBlock segments timed to the YouTube video are applied to the local file, Redownload becomes available on it (which deletes it, F03), conflict prompts stop appearing, and forced inserts lose the flag.
evidence: providers.dart:164-168 `if (!status.isGranted) { await openAppSettings(); }` is followed straight away by recovery at 181-185. metadata_service.dart:451-458 `updateTrackStatus(track.id, 'pending', clearFilePath: true, clearDownloadedAt: true, isLocalReplacement: false)` runs whenever no prefix file is listed.
suggested_fix: Run recovery and reconcile only when MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE is granted. Treat a listing with zero media files while the DB has complete tracks as 'unreadable' and change nothing. Never clear isLocalReplacement in reconcile; only the explicit replace and redownload flows should change it.

title: If thumbnail embedding fails (single-file webm from the '/best' fallback), a complete file is marked error and its artwork is deleted
scenario: For a video where neither 'bestvideo[ext=mp4]+bestaudio[ext=m4a]' nor 'best[ext=mp4]' is available, '/best' picks a single webm. yt-dlp switches webm to mkv only for merged formats, and EmbedThumbnailPP raises 'Supported filetypes for thumbnail embedding are: ...' for webm; that is reported as 'Postprocessing:' and yt-dlp exits 1. The app marks the track 'error' and a single-track download shows 'Download failed', although the complete .webm is on disk. Cleanup deletes the leftover thumbnail (F15). The next update adopts the webm as complete by prefix, with no artwork anywhere. m4a and mp4 outputs are fine.
evidence: Format `bestvideo[ext=mp4]+bestaudio[ext=m4a]/best[ext=mp4]/best` plus `--embed-thumbnail`. YoutubeDL.py:3489-3497 (webm -> mkv only for merged requested_formats); embedthumbnail.py:221-222 raises EmbedThumbnailPPError for any extension except mp3/mkv/mka/ogg/opus/flac/m4a/mp4/m4v/mov; YoutubeDL.py:3664 exits with error. In the catch, `updateTrackStatus(track.id, 'error', error: errorMsg)`; the file is never deleted (cleanup removes only images and transient files).
suggested_fix: For video playlists add `--remux-video webm>mkv` (or `--merge-output-format mkv`, or remux to mp4 per F27) so every output is an embeddable container. When yt-dlp fails with a 'Postprocessing:' thumbnail error but resolveMediaFile finds the media file, record it complete with a warning. Keep the thumbnail locally (F04).

title: The library and playback of downloaded files are unreachable if yt-dlp fails to initialise
scenario: YoutubeDL.init/FFmpeg.init fail, e.g. on the first launch after an install, reinstall or an update that changes the bundled Python runtime, on a phone whose storage is nearly full (plausible for someone backing up a large media library), so extracting the runtime throws. initProvider throws and InitWrapper shows only 'Failed to initialize: ...' with a Retry button. Home, playlists, search and playback of already-downloaded files are all blocked although none need yt-dlp. No network is involved, but it defeats 'fully available offline' for the whole library.
evidence: providers.dart:157 `await ytdlp.initialize();` is the first awaited step of initProvider. ytdlp_service.dart:24-33 retries only on MissingPluginException; a PlatformException ('INIT_ERROR', YtDlpPlugin.kt:106-108) propagates. main.dart:362-385: the error state renders only the message and Retry; HomePage is reached only on data.
suggested_fix: Take downloader setup off the critical path: catch and log ytdlp.initialize() failures (or run it unawaited) and still show HomePage. Keep a 'yt-dlp ready' flag and, while it is false, disable only Update/Download/Redownload/Fetch-chapters actions, with an explanation and a retry.
